diff --git a/openlibrary/plugins/upstream/tests/test_addbook.py b/openlibrary/plugins/upstream/tests/test_addbook.py
index a644a09..0daf9de 100644
--- a/openlibrary/plugins/upstream/tests/test_addbook.py
+++ b/openlibrary/plugins/upstream/tests/test_addbook.py
@@ -5,6 +5,57 @@ from openlibrary import accounts
 from openlibrary.mocks.mock_infobase import MockSite
 
 
+def test_make_work_without_author_fields():
+    for doc in (
+        {},
+        {'title': 'Untitled'},
+        {'title': 'Untitled', 'author_key': ['OL1A']},
+        {'title': 'Untitled', 'author_name': ['Author']},
+    ):
+        work = addbook.make_work(doc)
+
+        assert isinstance(work, web.Storage)
+        assert work.authors == []
+        assert work.cover_url == '/images/icons/avatar_book-sm.png'
+        assert work.ia == []
+        assert work.first_publish_year is None
+        for key, value in doc.items():
+            assert work[key] == value
+
+
+def test_make_work_creates_authors_and_preserves_metadata(monkeypatch):
+    created = []
+
+    def new(key, data):
+        author = object()
+        created.append((key, data, author))
+        return author
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(web.ctx, 'site', web.storage(new=new), raising=False)
+    doc = {
+        'title': 'Book',
+        'author_key': ['OL1A', 'OL2A'],
+        'author_name': ['First', 'Second'],
+        'cover_url': '/covers/custom.jpg',
+        'ia': ['example'],
+        'first_publish_year': 2000,
+    }
+
+    work = addbook.make_work(doc)
+
+    assert work.authors == [created[0][2], created[1][2]]
+    assert created[0][:2] == (
+        '/authors/OL1A',
+        {'key': '/authors/OL1A', 'type': {'key': '/type/author'}, 'name': 'First'},
+    )
+    assert created[1][:2] == (
+        '/authors/OL2A',
+        {'key': '/authors/OL2A', 'type': {'key': '/type/author'}, 'name': 'Second'},
+    )
+    for key, value in doc.items():
+        assert work[key] == value
+
+
 def strip_nones(d):
     return {k: v for k, v in d.items() if v is not None}
